memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "After Isaac finished blessing him, and Jacob had scarcely left his father's presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting. He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, 'My father, please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing.' His father Isaac asked him, 'Who are you?' 'I am your son,' he answered, 'your firstborn, Esau.' Isaac trembled violently and said, 'Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him—and indeed he will be blessed!'" - Gen 27:30-33 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The timing is razor-thin. Jacob has barely left when Esau walks in with his own meal, expecting his father's blessing. And the truth crashes down. Isaac "trembled violently" as he realised he had been deceived. Yet even in his shock, he says of Jacob, "and indeed he will be blessed!"

That violent trembling is the sound of a lie coming home. The deception could not stay hidden forever; the truth surfaced within minutes. However well we cover our tracks, hidden things have a way of coming to light (Luke 12:2). Sin promises secrecy, but the secret rarely keeps.

Notice Isaac's response once he sees the truth. Rather than reversing the blessing in anger, he recognises that God's hand has been at work — "indeed he will be blessed." In that moment Isaac seems to accept that God's purpose, which he had tried to bypass, would stand after all. His own scheme to bless Esau had failed; God's word held.

Two truths press on us here. Hidden things come to light, so it is better to walk in honesty now. And God's purposes will stand, even over our attempts to arrange life our own way. We can rest in a God whose plans are surer than ours.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I trusting that hidden things eventually come to light?
2. Where have I tried to arrange life my own way against God's clear will?
3. Can I rest in God's purposes even when my plans fail?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You bring hidden things to light and Your purposes always stand. Help me to walk honestly and to trust Your plans above my own. Amen.
